_howto: Asset Tagging & Stock Control tours. Screens open with switchTab(); the menu links have ids tab-<screen>. POS Settings tabs are drawn by AssetPOSSettings.js and its add-ons.
title: Asset Tagging tour
whatsNewText: We've added something new here since you last took the tour.

steps.title: Welcome to Asset Tagging & Stock Control
steps.text:
Keep track of your assets and stock, and run a point of sale for your shop or canteen, including sales on employee accounts.

Use Next and Back, or your arrow keys. Press Esc to close.

steps.title: All screens
steps.text: Grouped into assets, Stock & Inventory, Point of Sale and tools. For stock, set up in this order: Warehouses, Stock Categories, Stock Catalog, then receive stock.

steps.title: Asset Registry
steps.text: Every asset with its tag: where it is, who has it, its condition, meter reading and service schedule.

steps.title: Asset Categories
steps.text: Groups of assets, such as Laptops, Vehicles or Tools.

steps.title: Locator Report
steps.text: Where each asset is now, and which are in storage.

steps.title: Movement History
steps.text: Every move of an asset between people and places.

steps.title: Master Service History
steps.text: All services and repairs, with parts used.

steps.title: Stock Catalog
steps.text: Items you keep in stock, with their barcodes; serialised items are tracked one by one.

steps.title: Stock Categories
steps.text: Groups for your stock items.

steps.title: Warehouses
steps.text: Where stock is kept; a warehouse can also be a consumption point or a fuel store.

steps.title: Live Inventory & GRV
steps.text: How much of each item is in each warehouse. Receive stock (GRV) and transfer or consume it.

steps.title: GRV Manager
steps.text: Goods-received notes: drafts, completed, cancelled, and shortages still to arrive.

steps.title: POS Settings
steps.text: Set up your shop or canteen till: items and prices, cashiers and their rights, layout, cash, returns, face payment and installed tills.

steps.title: POS Screen
steps.text: Opens the till in a new tab.

steps.title: Print Labels & Tags
steps.text: Print barcode labels for assets and stock.

steps.title: Search any screen
steps.text: Jump straight to any screen you have access to, in any module.

steps.title: Your menu
steps.text: Your profile, other areas of the system, Dark Mode and logout.

steps.title: Help & Tours
steps.text: Opens the same help menu as the ? button.

steps.title: Help is always here
steps.text: Click ? for this tour, a tour of the screen you're on, and how-to guides.

steps.title: You're all set
steps.text: Each screen also has its own short tour. It starts the first time you open that screen, and you can replay it any time from ?.

steps.title: Register Asset
steps.text: Tag, category, name, model, serial number, purchase date, service interval and meter, and who or where it's assigned to.

steps.title: Find an asset
steps.text: Search, or filter by category.

steps.title: Your assets
steps.text: Open one to move it, update its meter, log a service, or edit it.

steps.title: Add a category
steps.text: Type a name and add it. Deactivate categories you no longer use.

steps.title: Your categories
steps.text: Active and deactivated categories.

steps.title: Create Stock Item
steps.text: Code, category, name and barcodes. Tick serialised for items tracked one by one.

steps.title: Excel
steps.text: Download a blank template or the whole catalog, and upload many items at once.

steps.title: Your catalog
steps.text: Search or filter by category; open an item to change it or manage its barcodes.

steps.title: Add a category
steps.text: A name (and a description if you like). New stock items can then be put in it.

steps.title: Your categories
steps.text: How many items each has. Edit renames it (its items move with it); Deactivate stops it being offered for new items.

steps.title: Active and deactivated
steps.text: Deactivated categories can be reactivated.

steps.title: Add a warehouse
steps.text: A name, and whether it's a consumption point (stock sent there is used up) or a fuel store.

steps.title: Your warehouses
steps.text: Each warehouse and its settings.

steps.title: Receive GRV
steps.text: Stock that arrives: the order number, the warehouse, and the items (or each serial number). Save as a draft or complete it.

steps.title: Transfer / Consume
steps.text: Move stock between warehouses, or book it out as used, with a reason.

steps.title: What you have
steps.text: Per item and warehouse. Filter by warehouse.

steps.title: GRVs
steps.text: Drafts, completed and cancelled GRVs, and shortages: items ordered that haven't arrived yet.

steps.title: Where everything is
steps.text: Search, or show only assets that are unassigned and in storage.

steps.title: Every service
steps.text: Search, or filter by dates. Open a record to see the parts used.

steps.title: Everything for the till
steps.text: You only see the tabs your POS rights allow.

steps.title: Setup
steps.text: Company-wide POS rules: employee account (deduction) sales and limits, cash handling, returns, and face payment.

steps.title: Items & Prices
steps.text: Which stock items the till sells, and their prices (with price history).

steps.title: Users & Rights
steps.text: Who may use the till and what they may do: sell, return, cash out, void, stock take, cash-up.

steps.title: Layout
steps.text: The buttons on the till screen, grouped into categories.

steps.title: Tills
steps.text: Installed tills that keep selling when the internet is down. Download a package to install one on a till PC.

steps.title: History
steps.text: Sales, stock movements, employee transactions, deduction batches for payroll, stock takes, days and cash.
